content: Welcome to York Garden Center. How can I help you?
I'm looking for a plant for my mom's birthday. What's this one called?
Sweet William. Its name comes from the writer William Shakespeare.
That's interesting. What color will the flower be on this one?
This type is pink but there are also types of red and purple.
Good. When will the flower come?
Every spring. Then you need to cut it before the summer so it can return next year.
OK. When should I put it outside?
Well, it's August now. Wait until September to put it in the garden.
It's only 10 centimeters tall now, but in 2 or 3 years that will be 30 centimeters tall. Leave space for it.
I'd like to buy it. How much is it?
The normal price is $10 but it's only $8 this weekend because we have a special discount.
